myth: Tie a tight tourniquet above the bite to stop the venom.
correction: Do not apply a tight tourniquet. WHO actively discourages it. Tourniquets do not stop venom, they cut off blood supply and can cost the person their limb. If a tight band is already on, leave it for trained staff to release slowly at the hospital.
steps: Keep the person calm and still
Immobilise the whole body, especially the bitten limb
Remove rings, bangles, watches and tight clothing
Transport to a health facility with antivenom now
Watch breathing and consciousness on the way
marathi: त्याला शांत आणि शांत ठेवा. काहीही घट्ट बांधू नका आणि उपचाराकडे जाऊ नका. त्याला आता अँटीव्हेनॉमसह रुग्णालयात वाहनाने घेऊन आपत्कालीन क्रमांक: 108
